## ALSO has the right offer for you

Create holistic IT solutions with ALSO. Innovative applications from IoT to AI, from cybersecurity

**myStore,** the white-label solution for your digital marketplace.

Buy smart. Sell smart.

And our value-added services support you with such complex issues as migrations, automation or
security concepts.

We’ll keep you connected, competitive, and support your business across the digital landscape and

## Important resources for customers

Although AppRiver is now formally part of the OpenText family, you still have access to the support
and account portals you're used to.

**[Secure Cloud Login][99]**

[**Support Portal**][100]** **(Zixcorp.com) 

## FAQs (Frequently Asked Questions)

### What happened to AppRiver?

Quick history: AppRiver was acquired by Zix Corporation in 2019. Zix was then acquired by OpenText
in 2021. You've been directed to the OpenText Cybersecurity site, which represents the consolidated
product & service portfolios for AppRiver as well as our other products for data security and data
protection. 

### What's changed about my account team?

***Nothing. ***You'll still get the same great service and expertise that you're used to, just with
a new brand. (Tip: you should really check out our complete offering.)

### What's changed about managing my account?

***Nothing. ***We've simply consolidated the marketing aspects of the AppRiver website
within [https://cybersecurity.opentext.com][101], but the existing Secure Cloud portal has stayed in
place: [Secure Cloud Login][102]

### How do I contact support?

#### Encrypted Email Recipients:

Recipients of encrypted email who need assistance should contact the sending organization's support
group. This support contact information is provided on the portal login page.

#### ZixMail Non-Corporate Customers:

To open a ticket, please email [support@zixcorp.com][103]. Please allow up to 3 business hours for
email responses.

#### Corporate Customers:

Corporate customer administrators may contact us:
by phone (888-576-4949.),
by email ([support@zixcorp.com][104]), or 
via the [Support Portal][105] (Zixcorp.com).

# AppRiver is now part of OpenText™ Cybersecurity

The same team of Microsoft experts, now within the comprehensive cybersecurity portfolio of
OpenText.

[Customer resources][96][FAQs][97]

**Unlock more value from Microsoft with OpenText Cybersecurity.**

[Explore Microsoft solutions][98]

## Important resources for customers

Although AppRiver is now formally part of the OpenText family, you still have access to the support
and account portals you're used to.

**[Secure Cloud Login][99]**

[**Support Portal**][100]** **(Zixcorp.com) 

## FAQs (Frequently Asked Questions)

### What happened to AppRiver?

Quick history: AppRiver was acquired by Zix Corporation in 2019. Zix was then acquired by OpenText
in 2021. You've been directed to the OpenText Cybersecurity site, which represents the consolidated
product & service portfolios for AppRiver as well as our other products for data security and data
protection. 

### What's changed about my account team?

***Nothing. ***You'll still get the same great service and expertise that you're used to, just with
a new brand. (Tip: you should really check out our complete offering.)

### What's changed about managing my account?

***Nothing. ***We've simply consolidated the marketing aspects of the AppRiver website
within [https://cybersecurity.opentext.com][101], but the existing Secure Cloud portal has stayed in
place: [Secure Cloud Login][102]

### How do I contact support?

#### Encrypted Email Recipients:

Recipients of encrypted email who need assistance should contact the sending organization's support
group. This support contact information is provided on the portal login page.

#### ZixMail Non-Corporate Customers:

To open a ticket, please email [support@zixcorp.com][103]. Please allow up to 3 business hours for
email responses.

#### Corporate Customers:

Corporate customer administrators may contact us:
by phone (888-576-4949.),
by email ([support@zixcorp.com][104]), or 
via the [Support Portal][105] (Zixcorp.com).

#### Archive, Encrypt and Protect Customers:

For non-urgent issues, please email [support@zixcorp.com][106]. We will respond to the email within
3 business hours. For urgent issues, email support or open a ticket via the support portal then call
support at 888-576-4949.

### How do I use the support portal?

When you arrive on our support portal, you can immediately access knowledge base articles for
questions about email encryption and how to open an encrypted email. You can also access ZixMail
user instructions and software downloads of ZixMail. Corporate administrators will need to login for
additional knowledgebase articles and software downloads related to ZixGateway and the management of
all Zix solutions.

### What training is available for administrators?

After deployment, we offer three Tech Talk webinars for additional assistance and refreshers. Please
login to the customer support portal to register for the webinars.Additionally, Zix has posted
training videos in the ZixGateway section of the support portal.

### Is there any cost to upgrade or maintain my software?

All patches, updates and new software releases for Zix are included in your service. There is no
cost to upgrade. We recommend the use of latest versions, which are available in the downloads
section of our support portal.

### I received an email notification stating I have received an encrypted email. What do I do next?

Recipients of encrypted email can get support from the sending organization. The support email
address can be found on the login screen when clicking on the encrypted email notification link. If
you have any questions about why you received an encrypted email notification or the content of the
message, please contact the sender.

## Our Purpose**Helping our customers change the world**

Our customers are some of the world’s greatest organisations. We work hard to get to know them,
understand their needs and put them at the heart of everything we do. We work relentlessly to build
their long-term trust, so they can rely on us in a complex and ever-changing world.

## Who we are

### Centred around our customers

Computacenter is a leading independent technology and services provider, trusted by large corporate
and public sector organisations. We are a responsible business that believes in sustainable
long-term value creation.

We build unrivalled value for our customers over the long-term, helping them to achieve their goals.
It’s one of the reasons that we’re trusted by some of the world’s greatest organisations.

commitment for Computacenter. We take a responsible approach across our operations including our
environmental impact, and we believe in delivering positive social impact within our communities,
too. These are enduring principles for us.

_crawl.linkedin_about: Core BTS, an NRI Group Company, is a full-service digital transformation consultancy that helps the world’s most impactful companies leverage today’s most powerful technologies to transform from the inside out. We simplify technical complexity, accelerate transformation, and drive business outcomes for our clients. Headquartered in Indianapolis, IN, we help organizations leverage cutting-edge technologies including AI, security, hybrid infrastructure, data, applications, modern work, and managed services. Our promise? Practicality: Our roots in infrastructure and cloud technology run deep, empowering us to navigate hybrid cloud environments with assurance. Simplicity: We simplify complex environments using proprietary tools that accelerate project discovery, connect disparate information, and automate manual processes. Our delivery framework provides a level of detail and pragmatism that’s second to none. Speed: Agility is our forte. We anticipate shifts in client needs and market trends and swiftly adapt. Our change management program minimizes business disruption, engages end-users, and accelerates time to value. Comprehensive Support: Our seasoned experts accompany you at every step of your digital journey, overcoming challenges as opportunities. From strategic planning through implementation and beyond, Core BTS is your unwavering ally. Trusted by companies of all sizes across all industries, we've earned our stripes through proven results and unwavering dedication. We're here to transform your vision into reality. Learn more at corebts.com.

D&H Distributing mourns the passing of Izzy Schwab, Chairman Emeritus and a lifelong steward of
the company.

Izzy's leadership, humility, and belief in people helped shape D&H into what it is today, serving
partners and communities across North America. His values continue to guide the teams at D&H.
Those wishing to share a memory or reflection are invited to visit our digital tribute wall.

[Visit Our Tribute Wall and Share Your Stories][40]

In lieu of flowers, the family has shared that those who wish to honor Izzy's memory may consider
a contribution to either of these two organizations, causes close to his heart.

Make-A-Wish
Philadelphia, Delaware & Susquehanna Valley

Humane Society of Harrisburg Area/Central PA

_crawl.linkedin_about: Exclusive Networks is a global trusted cybersecurity specialist for digital infrastructure helping to drive the transition to a totally trusted digital future for all people and organisations. Our distinctive approach to distribution gives partners more opportunity and more customer relevance. Our specialism is their strength – equipping them to capitalise on rapidly evolving technologies and transformative business models. The Exclusive story is a global one with a services-first ideology at its core, harnessing innovation and disruption to deliver partner value. With offices in 43 countries and the ability to service customers in over 170 countries across five continents, Exclusive combine the extreme focus and value of local independents with the scale and service delivery of a single worldwide distribution powerhouse. Join our team: www.exclusive-networks.com/about-exclusive-networks/careers/

## customers, from the world’s leading vendors and carriers.

[**Become a Partner**][87]
[**Why join us**][88]

## **Grow faster with Giacom**

**Access cloud, comms, hardware and software on our newly enhanced specialist marketplace designed
exclusively for the channel. Create bespoke offerings tailored to meet the needs of today’s SMBs,
all from one self-service platform.**

With an incredible selection of the best products, dedicated capabilities, outstanding value, and
ongoing support, you can choose exactly what you need to succeed.

**Watch our video** to see how you can grow faster with Giacom and explore everything we have to
offer you.

Cloud Market Platform

## Have the freedom of choice

Explore a digital marketplace that’s designed around you – with carefully curated products and
services specially selected for the SMB market. Gain exceptional value at scale, so you can expand
into new areas.

[Discover the Cloud Market platform][89]

## Cloud, chosen just for you

Always keep pace with changing cloud preferences and trends, with our selection of hand-picked
solutions and value added support. Bring your customers the best of cloud, faster.

[Discover cloud success][90]

## Comms without complexity

Expand your comms portfolio with simple, scalable connectivity solutions your customers will love.
We provide one place to buy and provision your selected services, with comprehensive lifecycle
support.

[Discover Business Mobile][91]
[Discover Business Broadband and Ethernet][92]
[Discover IP Communications][93]

## Hardware that adapts with you

Explore our varied and ever-evolving hardware portfolio, enabling you to always adapt and meet
changing customer needs while unlocking unique opportunities to expand your offering and customer
base.

[Discover leading hardware][94]

Support

as a Managed Services Provider with:
* Learning and development
* Marketing resources
* Expertise and industry knowledge

_crawl.linkedin_about: Ignition was established to help new and emerging technology vendors fast track their go-to-market strategy in a two-tier distribution model. Ignition focuses on choosing technology solutions that are complementary, or a refresh opportunity, for our channel partners. Having looked at a multitude of solutions in the last few years in the networking and security market we are a filter for new technology. Unlike other traditional distributors/VADs in the market we validate our technology choices by the people that make the buying decisions - end users. Ignition has a large community of enterprise end users that review and test new technology before we take it to channel. This is the only way to perform our due-diligence. Ignition is a channel only organisation.

### Almacenamiento

Potencializa la demanda regional en localizaciones estratégicas a través de nuestro inventario de
disponibilidad inmediata especialmente concebido para garantizar la reposición y entrega expedita de
productos.

### Selección, empaque, flete y facturación

Intcomex dispone de un procedimiento flexible de selección, empaque y despacho con el fin de
preparar todo tipo de pedidos, sin importar su complejidad.

### Servicios de aduana e importación

La complejidad del comercio internacional jamás debe limitar la magnitud de tu participación en el
mercado.

### Seguimiento de pedidos


Gracias a nuestro sistema de gestión y seguimiento, es posible conocer el estatus de pedidos en cada
etapa del proceso de envío hasta que estos sean recibidos en su destino en perfectas condiciones y
en la fecha programada.

### Distribución local de mercancía


Nos encargamos de entregar tu producto donde lo necesites, a tiempo y dentro de tu presupuesto.
Contamos con una cadena de distribución fiable basada en una red de transporte y en la optimización
de rutas.

### Logística inversa


El fabricante por lo general gasta un porcentaje significativo de su ingreso total en procesar
devoluciones. El ciclo de la cadena de distribución no termina necesariamente con la entrega de
productos en su destino final.

América Latina y el Caribe, como la plataforma líder en distribución de productos de tecnología y
soluciones de valor agregado. [Conoce más sobre nuestro propósito][41] [Intcomex] Conviértete en
socio estratégico de Intcomex.
Haz clic aquí para obtener más
información:
[Hacerse cliente][42]

###### Fabricantes

Somos la mejor opción para las principales marcas, que depositan su confianza en nuestro amplio
conocimiento de la industria para expandir su alcance en la región.

[Ver Más][43]

###### Retailers

Transforma la experiencia del cliente en el punto de venta.

[Ver Más][44]

###### Canales de valor agregado

Los clientes son la fuerza que impulsa a nuestra organización. El crecimiento de nuestros clientes
es nuestro principal objetivo.

[Ver Más][45]

###### Operadores

Para los operadores líderes en telecomunicaciones, el hecho de mantenerse enfocados en su propio
negocio jamás debería ser un desafío.

[Ver Más][46]
+14
Contamos con una presencia local basada en una red propia de 14 subsidiarias.
+50000
Atendemos a más de 50 mil canales de distribución.
+180
Fabricantes con un portafolio de más de 12.000 productos.
100000
Metros cuadrados de capacidad en 24 puntos de almacenamiento y distribución.

### Almacenamiento

Potencializa la demanda regional en localizaciones estratégicas a través de nuestro inventario de
disponibilidad inmediata especialmente concebido para garantizar la reposición y entrega expedita de
productos.

### Selección, empaque, flete y facturación

Intcomex dispone de un procedimiento flexible de selección, empaque y despacho con el fin de
preparar todo tipo de pedidos, sin importar su complejidad.

### Servicios de aduana e importación

La complejidad del comercio internacional jamás debe limitar la magnitud de tu participación en el
mercado.

### Seguimiento de pedidos


Gracias a nuestro sistema de gestión y seguimiento, es posible conocer el estatus de pedidos en cada
etapa del proceso de envío hasta que estos sean recibidos en su destino en perfectas condiciones y
en la fecha programada.

### Distribución local de mercancía


Nos encargamos de entregar tu producto donde lo necesites, a tiempo y dentro de tu presupuesto.
Contamos con una cadena de distribución fiable basada en una red de transporte y en la optimización
de rutas.

### Logística inversa


El fabricante por lo general gasta un porcentaje significativo de su ingreso total en procesar
devoluciones. El ciclo de la cadena de distribución no termina necesariamente con la entrega de
productos en su destino final.

consist of distribution, technical support, assembly, repairs and financing for our partner base.

requirements. These insights allow us to offer a range of products and services in line with
shifting needs and trends. Our aim is to empower our partners’ businesses that they are able to
thrive and grow.

businesses. Our open-door policy and ‘can-do-entrepreneurial spirit’ makes us easy to work with. We
partner with tier 1 vendors to provide only the best solutions for the channel.
Based in South Africa, we have a broad national footprint and the ability to service resellers and
retailers across Southern Africa.

_crawl.linkedin_about: Prianto GmbH was founded in 2009 in Germany by William Geens and Oliver Roth as a starting point. Prianto is positioned in the distribution market as a pure play software distributor. Over the last years Prianto has grown into a group of companies covering the IT markets in Europe and Canada. Today Prianto is a leading software distributor with a focussed vendor portfolio. It is our mission to be a trusted partner for resellers, system integrators and Managed Service Providers and to market innovative software solutions that make digital infrastructures and corporate workplaces more efficient. Since 2011, Prianto has also been present in the UK, Austria and Switzerland, followed by the BeNeLux countries in 2012, Poland in 2014 and France in 2016. Branches were opened in 2017 in the Czech Republic, Hungary, Slovakia and the Adriatics. Since 2019 Prianto is also in Canada. We rely on absolute channel loyalty and sell only to IT resellers (VARs, system houses, integrators, Managed Service Providers, etc.). Our goal is to establish long-term, trustworthy and successful business relationships with reseller partners and international vendors. For this, we offer a high-margin and innovative software solutions, guaranteeing fast and well-founded software licensing services, as well as dedicated "Go-To-Market" strategies.

_crawl.linkedin_about: RAH Infotech enables enterprise technology adoption across cybersecurity, compliance, cloud, infrastructure and data centre modernisation through a curated ecosystem of leading OEM technologies, technical expertise and partner enablement. With more than two decades of experience, RAH works with OEMs, technology partners and enterprise-focused channel organisations to map the right solutions to the right business requirements. The focus is simple: help partners address complex customer needs with stronger solution design, sharper pre-sales support and greater delivery confidence. RAH’s portfolio spans network and perimeter security, endpoint and XDR, identity and access, data protection, cloud security, application security, SASE, security operations, GRC, infrastructure management, networking, cloud services and data centre build and management services. Beyond product access, RAH supports partners with technical guidance, solution mapping, implementation support, managed services capability and compliance-led expertise. This includes areas such as SOC, DPDPA readiness, VAPT, ISO management system services, infrastructure operations and data centre modernisation. In a market where technology stacks are becoming more fragmented, RAH helps bring structure to the ecosystem — connecting OEM innovation, partner reach and enterprise requirements into more resilient, governed and scalable technology outcomes. With 55+ security products, 100+ technical experts, 500+ enterprise customers and 750+ channel partners, RAH continues to support India’s enterprise technology ecosystem with depth, coverage and execution discipline.

## Who we are

Westcon-Comstor is a global technology distributor specialising in cybersecurity, networking, and
hybrid cloud solutions.

As growth architects of the channel, we connect technology from the world’s leading vendors with a
channel of IT partners, helping them seize opportunities and turn potential into growth.

 

 

##  

## Partner Success. It’s what we do.

Partner Success is our 40-year heritage of enabling vendors and partners to grow. With a
digital-first approach, data-driven processes, and trusted partnerships, we help partners create
future-proof businesses so they can proactively help their end-customers get the most from
technology and deliver Customer Success. 

[Partner_Success_banner_wide]

## PartnerCentral

### Our unified digital gateway for Partner Success.

PartnerCentral is our secure partner portal and digital platform, providing a single place for
everything you need to succeed in today’s IT channel.

We take our responsibility seriously. Our strategy comprises three pillars: people, planet, and

Our portfolio of specialist vendors includes global and early-stage companies offering
class-leading, proven technologies and the latest innovative solutions on the market. Our dedicated

Careers are more than just ‘jobs’ – they’re a journey. Whether you’re kickstarting your career or a

We commenced our MEA operations in 2011 with a clear focus on value added distribution. Our mission to empower organizations with the ability to effectively manage their “digital assets”, to protect, to comply and to grow their business. Our vision is to Maximize the value of technology investments by aligning them with prevailing business challenges to create business benefits for our customers Our approach is very unique we adopt a consultative model and our teams have been instructed to follow the 3 basic steps before approaching any customer ; 1. Understand the customers business 2, Understand the challenges faced by the customer 3. Offer solutions in line with the business goals and objectives Our approach to parrtners is also tailored to avoid partner conflicts and to ensure that partners are treated with respect Our goals are to provide our partners with prompt delivery and timely support with very attractive terms.

_crawl.about: Indian Society for Quality (ISQ) was established in 1996 as a Not-for-Profit Society with the objective of providing a national forum for interaction among quality professionals. The society acts as a catalyst and facilitation body for exchange of information and experience regarding Quality management principles, technology and practices. Its mission is to pursue quality for prosperity. Towards its objectives, ISQ has instituted many awards to recognize outstanding contributions by industry leaders, business professionals, TQM promoters in quality bodies and TQM counsellors who have selflessly contributed to the quality movement in India through their leadership and knowledge. As a member of Asian Network for Quality (ANQ) involved from the very outset and represented on its Board, ISQ is the face of India overseas in the world of quality. ISQ hosted the 2nd ANQ Congress in 2004 in New Delhi as well as the 2010 ANQ Congress at Noida in which 800 participants, including 170 from overseas participated and 214 papers were presented. ISQ continues to represent India actively in ANQ Congresses. It also maintains the ANQ website cooperation with member organizations from various Asian countries. The flagship event of ISQ is its Annual Conference where awards are presented, and illustrious speakers from India and overseas are invited. ISQ also reaches out to its constituents through a variety of open training programs and seminars from time to time. One of the prestigious program conducted in 2018 was Jishu Kotei Kanketsu (JKK) by senior leaders from Toyota, and attended by CEOs as well as quality assurance professionals. Membership of ISQ is open to individual professionals from all fields: academia, consulting, manufacturing and service organizations, besides government, education, healthcare and NGOs.
